description: §55.17.3: submitting a form that binds a validated top-level value while it is invalid (`""` fails `req`) does NOT run the form's onsubmit (calls stays 0), marks the value touched and submitted, and the compiler reports the gate (I-FORM-SUBMIT-GATED).
rationale: §55.17.3: "On each gated form's `submit` event, the compiler-emitted gate SHALL run before any author handler and synchronously … 1. Touch … 2. Submitted … 3. Block if invalid. If any of those values has `isValid == false`, cancel the submission: prevent the event's default action (no native navigation, no native POST) and do not run the author's `onsubmit`." §55.17.6: "I-FORM-SUBMIT-GATED (Info, §34) — one per gated form, at the form's opener". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "validity calls 2-6" call 2 (G2) + "the four §55.17 OPEN items" item 1.

codes: severity:code 'I-FORM-SUBMIT-GATED' did not fire (expected severity info)
